comments.author: Pinnacle
comments.body: Where can I find Franco Thanude in the Antiles for this?

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: He's best seen sailing in and out of Santo Domingo. Im not sure about his exact sailing pattern in the Antilles, but your best bet is to wait out in front of Santo Domingo. He'll eventually appear sooner or later.

wiki: Note: This Job Card can also be obtained by using x1 Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers for Receive Endorsement and then receiving it from Franco Thanude (Spain NPC that sails to/from Santo Domingo in Caribbean - Antilles, Open Sea).
